definitions.gloss: to wail; to cry loudly; to sob uncontrollably
definitions.explanation: To cry loudly and openly, with audible sobbing. Stronger than simply crying (泣く). Often used in dramatic or emotional contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{感動|かんどう}して→感動する：21603_kandousuru⟧{号泣|ごうきゅう}した。
examples.english: I was so moved that I cried my eyes out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ラスト→ラスト：30487_rasuto⟧⟦シーン→シーン：08914_shiin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{観客|かんきゃく}→観客：02556_kankyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{号泣|ごうきゅう}して⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The audience was sobbing during the last scene of the movie.

examples.japanese: ⟦{卒業式|そつぎょうしき}→卒業式：05584_sotsugyoushiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{別|わか}れ→別れ：03788_wakare⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{辛|つら}くて→辛い：01112_tsurai⟧、⟦{人前|ひとまえ}→人前：19380_hitomae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{号泣|ごうきゅう}してしまった。
examples.english: At the graduation ceremony, parting with my friends was so painful that I ended up wailing in front of everyone.

notes:
USAGE:
Originally a strong literary word meaning to cry with loud, audible sobs. In modern casual usage, especially online and among younger speakers, ⟦{号泣|ごうきゅう}→号泣：15038_goukyuu⟧ is often used more loosely to mean "crying a lot" or even "tearing up," somewhat diluting its original intensity.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{感動|かんどう}して→感動する：21603_kandousuru⟧{号泣|ごうきゅう}する (to cry from being moved)
- ⟦{人前|ひとまえ}→人前：19380_hitomae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{号泣|ごうきゅう}する (to cry in public)
- {号泣|ごうきゅう}する⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧ (a movie that makes you cry)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{泣|な}く→泣く：00655_naku⟧: The basic word for crying — neutral in intensity.
- ⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{流|なが}す→流す：01968_nagasu⟧: To shed tears — more literary, can be quiet.
- ⟦{嗚咽|おえつ}→嗚咽：16567_oetsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: To sob, to choke up — emphasizes the physical act of sobbing with a constricted voice.
